settings.title: How to use
settings.content:
1. Choose the shade closest to your skin tone.
2. Press a small amount under the eyes with the applicator or a brush.
3. Blend outward with soft taps until it melts into your skin.
4. Build up in thin layers wherever you need more coverage.

settings.question: How do I choose my shade?
settings.answer: Light Bisque and Warm Bisque suit light to medium skin, while Extra Deep Peach and Very Deep Beige are made for deep skin tones. When in doubt between two shades, pick the warmer one — it blends more naturally under the eyes.

settings.question: When will I receive my order?
settings.answer: Orders are processed within 24–48 hours and typically delivered within 7 to 14 business days. You'll get a tracking link by email as soon as your order ships.

settings.question: Is it suitable for sensitive skin?
settings.answer: The formula is designed to be gentle and breathable for everyday wear. If your skin is very reactive, review the full ingredient list above and patch-test on a small area first.

settings.question: What if this product doesn't work for me?
settings.answer: You're covered by our 30-day satisfaction guarantee: return the product and we'll refund you in full.
